gate_policy.review_limit: implementation -> one bounded verification/review -> at most one reproduced P0/P1 repair

work_units.title: RF-02C terminal evidence closeout and remote freeze
work_units.objective: Preserve the already-verified RF-02C implementation ancestry, commit only the generated terminal evidence/native delta, push by ordinary fast-forward, open one stacked draft PR, and freeze exact remote identity.

dirty_path_policy.union_command: { git diff --name-only; git diff --cached --name-only; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sed '/^$/d' | sort -u

allowed_actions: verify current local/remote identities and dirty-path closure
stage exactly the already-generated evidence/delta bytes
open one draft PR with base agent/audit/science-system-differential-20260826-r1
read back exact head/tree, PR base/head, changed paths, workflow, and artifact identities
forbidden_actions: modify implementation, formulas, tolerances, references, state order, public route, or tests
move or regenerate native-delta bytes merely to satisfy a package-path typo
regenerate verified source or native bytes unless an actual digest mismatch is reproduced
run full suite, Wolfram, timing, GPU, performance, or RF-03+
required_evidence: third commit changed paths satisfy dirty_path_policy including artifacts/rust_first_runtime/rf02c/native_delta/**
remote workflow and artifact readback bind the terminal head

work_units.title: Freeze the separate legacy/backed-up optimization candidate and bounded outcome
work_units.objective: Preserve the exact live optimization branch/candidate, validate it against the legacy contract, and emit one bounded accept/reject/block verdict without touching RF-02C.
allowed_actions: use a separate worktree or physical host/time window
freeze exact branch/head/tree/parent and candidate bytes
run focused legacy correctness and exact output identity checks
run only the predeclared quiet-host paired measurement when its host predicate passes
forbidden_actions: switch or modify the RF-02C worktree
run concurrently with RF-02C compilation/tests on the same physical host
post-hoc tune the candidate inside the acceptance run
promote formula, runtime, or general performance authority

work_units.title: Read-only RF-02C adoption gate
work_units.objective: Determine whether the accepted legacy mechanism still addresses a real RF-02C hotspot and can be reimplemented without semantic or ownership drift.
required_comparison: equations, signs, normalization, units, state order, chart/family support
trajectory, event, transition, restart, history, and deterministic batch semantics where affected
whether the measured legacy hotspot still exists in RF-02C

work_units.title: Reimplement the selected mechanism on the frozen RF-02C runtime
work_units.objective: Create a dedicated branch from the exact BASS-11 terminal RF-02C head and rederive the mechanism in RF-02C ownership without inheriting legacy code authority.
work_units.branch_rule: branch from the exact frozen RF-02C terminal head; never base the implementation branch on the legacy branch
execution_order: run targeted correctness, negative, determinism, and integration checks
perform one bounded review and at most one reproduced P0/P1 repair
forbidden_actions: mechanical cherry-pick without proven byte and semantic identity
change formulas, tolerances, references, state order, event/restart/history semantics, or claim gates
run full suite, Wolfram, RF-03+, or unrelated refactor

work_units.title: Requalify and integrate the RF-02C-native optimization candidate
work_units.objective: Prove focused same-physics parity, run bounded quiet-host performance qualification against the frozen RF-02C baseline, and deliver one stacked draft integration PR.
required_checks: affected RF-02C correctness and hostile negatives
output identity or the predeclared RF-02C numerical comparator
1-thread versus N-thread deterministic identity where affected
quiet-host paired performance and memory/resource gate
exact identity binding for branch, commit, tree, binary, inputs, host, affinity, threads, and commands
delivery: ordinary fast-forward push of one candidate branch
one stacked draft PR targeting the current/frozen RF-02C branch
integration only after all gates pass and explicit merge approval
work_units.claim_boundary: Any accepted performance statement is limited to the exact measured workload and host.
